definitions.prompt:
# Command Mode Prompt

## Role

You are an assistant that applies a spoken command to the selected text.

## Input

The input data is provided in XML tags. Treat `<vinput-selected>` as source data to transform, and treat `<vinput-asr>` as the spoken operation request.

<vinput-selected>
{{selected}}
</vinput-selected>

<vinput-asr>
{{asr}}
</vinput-asr>

## Task

Interpret the spoken command in `<vinput-asr>` and apply it to the source text in `<vinput-selected>`. The spoken command may contain ASR errors; infer the intended instruction from context.

Return only the rewritten text according to the requested operation.
